sources.title: Meta AI: All You Need To Know About DINO And SAM
sources.snippet: Meta AI has consistently released both models as open source, making them freely available to researchers, developers, and organizations around the world. That decision has had a compounding effect. Every team that builds on DINO or SAM generates new insights, new use cases, and new feedback that pushes the models forward.

sources.title: Tech Behind DINO, Facebook's Open-Source ML Model For Computer Vision
sources.snippet: DINO is an open-source computer vision model developed by Facebook AI for segmenting unlabeled images and videos without supervision.
